accepted_claims: A sufficient exact rotational-reduction admission predicate is established when the exact durable target material is axisymmetric about the declared spindle axis, the setup is exactly coaxial, and engaged cutter placement factors as K(q,theta)=R_theta A(q) over Q x S1 with phase-independent A(q) and full phase coverage for every q.

Under that predicate the cutter sweep and regularized post-cut material are rotationally invariant, so the operation may be represented in the exact meridian quotient without rewriting the source journal.

Operation labels such as OD turning or facing are not admission evidence; nonaxisymmetric targets, eccentric setups, synchronized/timed-phase geometry, partial phase coverage and finite angle sampling reject the quotient path.

The bounded exact-rational meridian-rectangle implementation preserves equality, signed neighbours, simultaneous radial/axial source correlation, exact zero-contact semantics, symbolic solid-of-revolution volume and disconnected parting remnants.
Rejected phase-sensitive/eccentric cases route to MC-022 rather than being approximated into axisymmetry; re-clamp/reorientation composition remains MC-023.
open_claims: PB-007-01 remains OPEN for required tangential/multiple/singular transcendental phase events outside the full-orbit factorization.
PB-007-02 remains OPEN for the general coupled helical/spindle-feed/eccentric sweep route.
PB-007-03 remains propagated from the arbitrary form/undercut cutter source-codec gap.
The general phase-sensitive lathe sweep remains owned by MC-022; MC-021 does not claim all conventional turning is reducible.
PO-02, PO-04, PO-05 and PO-06 remain OPEN.
MC-B, MC-C, MC-D, MC-E, MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
adversarial_controls: reject nonaxisymmetric target material even when the cutter orbit is rotationally invariant
reject partial phase coverage and finite sampled-angle substitution
reject epsilon or binary-float exact-contact authority
reject loss of either parting remnant or quotient-component promotion to durable identity authority
reject inherited-blocker closure or premature MC-B promotion
